observations.fact: Listing fee observed at USD 0.20 per listing and transaction fee observed at 6.5%; setup/payment-processing details can vary.
Direct Gumroad website sales observed at 10% + USD 0.50 plus processing; Discover marketplace sales observed at 30%.
Google Play Books accepts PDF or EPUB, states no cost to sell books, and does not require digital-edition exclusivity; availability is country/region dependent.
Apple Books direct web publishing requires an iTunes Connect account and an EPUB file plus cover/sample/description.
KDP digital books expose 35% and 70% royalty options subject to eligibility/territory conditions.

Draft2Digital distributes to multiple online retail and library partners including Apple Books, Barnes & Noble, Kobo, OverDrive, cloudLibrary, Everand, Hoopla and others; Amazon distribution is observed as invitation-only.
Notion Marketplace supports paid templates after creator/payment review; third-party payment links are also supported, and direct Marketplace payments use a platform fee model.
Lemon Squeezy ecommerce pricing observed at 5% + USD 0.50 per transaction with no monthly ecommerce fee, subject to additional-fee conditions.
Registry intentionally treats new-author intake as paused based on current observed author-help state; recheck before activation.

policy: Dynamic platform fees/rules are dated observations and must be rechecked before live publication.
